text_blocks.snippet: Foot pain can be a symptom of COVID-19, particularly in cases of long COVID. While not as common as respiratory symptoms, some individuals experience nerve pain and numbness in their feet as a manifestation of peripheral neuropathy associated with long COVID, according to Yale Medicine. This nerve pain can manifest as a burning, aching, or tingling sensation, and may worsen with activity. Additionally, the pandemic itself has indirectly led to foot problems, as increased time spent at home and changes in footwear have contributed to conditions like Achilles tendonitis and tendonitis.
